lines: I remember having no trade, no thoughts, almost no self. You helped with the important one.
I did not know what I would become, but you made sure I could become anything.
You helped pull me back when even my name felt far away.
Your face is familiar. So is being confused, but this feels different.
I remember waking with empty hands and a head full of broken bells.
The memory is rough around the edges, but your face stayed in it.
I remember you, though I still do not know what to do with the memory.
I know you helped. I also remember why my hands still shake.
The cure left echoes behind. Stand where I can breathe around them.
